# 1ai-content

> Telegram bot SaaS platform for AI-powered video generation. Multi-provider AI with 9-tier fallback, credit-based pricing, BullMQ job queues, and admin dashboard. Part of the 1ai ecosystem (1ai-content + 1ai-social + 1ai-affiliate).

## Docs

- [docs/01-ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/01-ARCHITECTURE.md) — Components, data flow, architecture
- [docs/02-ROUTES.md](docs/02-ROUTES.md) — API & bot routes
- [docs/03-SECURITY.md](docs/03-SECURITY.md) — Security policies & procedures
- [docs/04-FRONTEND.md](docs/04-FRONTEND.md) — Frontend SaaS (admin/customer/landing Vue SPAs)
- [docs/05-TESTING.md](docs/05-TESTING.md) — Testing conventions
- [docs/06-EXECUTION.md](docs/06-EXECUTION.md) — Execution & deployment guides
- [docs/AGENTS.md](docs/AGENTS.md) — Docs conventions
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md) — Docs index
- [docs/db-consolidation-plan.md](docs/db-consolidation-plan.md) — DB consolidation plan

> Catatan: section Docs sebelumnya merujuk `docs/00-overview.md`, `docs/01-architecture.md`, `docs/04-api-reference.md`, `docs/ECOSYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/AUDIT_REPORT.md`, dst. — file tsb tidak ada di repo; daftar di atas adalah file aktual.
